claim_start.statement: Optimism states on 2022-05-31 that OP Airdrop #1 is live and eligible recipients can claim.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
The page's broader incentive-program amount is not assigned to this claim-opening fact.
Day precision is retained because the official page does not publish a UTC claim-opening clock time.
